newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CVNE to start 22.46 pct IPO sale on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Spain CVNE to start 22.46 pct IPO sale on Monday.

text.p: Spanish wine producer Compania Vinicola del Norte de Espana (CVNE) will sell 22.46 percent in an initial public offering that will begin on Monday, stock market watchdog the CNMV said on Friday.

The 22.46 percent initial offer of 724,815 shares is divided into a subscription and sale offer, composed of 6.81 percent and 15.65 percent, respectively. Both offers have the same rights, without any distinctions, the CNMV said.
In addition, there is a 2.97 percent option to buy shares offered by the offer's underwriter, and global coordinator Chase Manhattan Bank.
The CNMV said the public offer would last from July 7 to July 16. The price will be fixed on Saturday July 12, which will be within a band from 3,400 to 3,900 pesetas.

BSN, one of the agents involved in the placing, said of the initial offer, 75 percent would be destined for the retail market and 25 percent to the institutional buyers. The sale will be conducted domestically, it added.
BSN said the shares would begin trading on July 22, and the purchase period would be between July 14 and 16.
CVNE said in June it would sell 21.72 percent of its capital, but the CNMV said the amount had changed marginally in the design of the IPO, with the sale offer increasing slightly.
